text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Servant of the Kaiser!
Your path of evil ends here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
覇瞳皇帝のしもべよ！
ここは我らが通さんぞ！

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text: We'll give you a bashing like you've never seen before!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ワタシたちが
ぜーんぶブッ潰してやるデース！

text_block_list.name: Monika
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh!
Ninon?!
Where did you pop up from?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁぁっ！
ニノン！？
どこから湧いてきたっ？

text_block_list.name: Ninon
text_block_list.text:
A ninja of the east appears when least expected!
Now let's party!
text_block_list.orig_text:
トーゴクのシノビは
神出キボツなのデース！
レッツ、パーティ！
